Add music-reactive shader playground + gh-pages PR previews

Drops in a self-contained music-reactive WebGPU shader playground at
public/playgrounds/shader-reactive.html (iPad-friendly, WebGL2 preview
with Web Audio FFT, copyable WGSL prompt). Wires up the
brandon-fryslie/gh-pages-multiplexer action so every PR and push to
main/master gets its own versioned preview URL.
